Seasonal cycle

Area-weighted all-India monthly rainfall. Colours: winter, pre-monsoon, SW monsoon, post-monsoon.

Interannual variability

Coefficient of variation of seasonal totals (standard deviation ÷ mean).

All-India rainfall through time

Top: annual totals, 11-year running mean and linear trend. Bottom: JJAS departure from the 1901–2024 mean — blue ≥ +10 % (excess), red ≤ −10 % (deficient).

Grid-point trends

Linear (OLS) trend of seasonal totals. Dots mark cells where p < 0.05. Brown = drying, green = wetting.

Data & methods

  • Data: IMD 0.25° × 0.25° gridded daily rainfall (Pai et al., 2014), 1901–2024. Fill values (−999) are treated as missing.
  • 3D surface: day-weighted seasonal means of the monthly climatology, gap-filled at the coast, Gaussian-smoothed (σ = 1 grid cells) for display only. Hover values are the smoothed field.
  • All-India series: cos(latitude)-weighted means over land cells. Departures are relative to the period mean, not IMD's official LPA, so excess/deficient counts may differ slightly from IMD bulletins.
  • Trends: ordinary least squares on yearly totals; two-sided t-test for significance, without correction for autocorrelation or field significance.
  • Boundaries: Natural Earth (50m) — illustrative only; this is not the official Survey of India boundary.
